alice_market_value.meaning: current market value of Alice's pre-existing profitable share position
alice_market_value.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

alice_basis_before.meaning: Alice's own cost basis for her pre-existing position before any incoming basis is merged
alice_basis_before.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

bob_basis_incoming.meaning: Bob's high-cost basis attached to the shares he transfers to Alice
bob_basis_incoming.checkpoint: before Bob transfers shares to Alice

alice_basis_after.meaning: Alice's average cost basis after the incoming basis is merged into her existing basis
alice_basis_after.checkpoint: after Bob transfers shares to Alice

basis_inflated.meaning: Alice's post-merge average cost basis equals or exceeds the current market value of her shares
basis_inflated.checkpoint: after Bob transfers shares to Alice

assumptions: Bob's transferred shares carry his high-cost basis into Alice's account via _transferBasis.
Alice's pre-existing position and the incoming position are accounted under the same userBasis variable.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the numeric merge rule for _transferBasis, so the exact post-merge basis value cannot be derived; only the reported inflated-basis outcome is bound.

limitations: Formalizes only the inflated_basis impact; fee evasion and market-creation impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The relation asserts the reported desired correspondence that Alice's post-merge basis stays below market value; the impact is the negation of that relation.
